dict.string: Wockett reads your steps and walking distance to track your daily goal, and your sleep, heart rate (resting, walking and variability), active calories, flights climbed, and walking speed, step length and symmetry to show your recovery and walking health.
Wockett saves your walks, runs and rides to Apple Health, including distance, duration, active calories and the route, so they count toward your Move and Exercise rings.

Wockett uses your location to suggest nearby walking routes, track your position during in-app navigation, and calculate distances. Route coordinates are sent to a free elevation service (opentopodata.org) to display elevation profiles.
Wockett counts your steps using the device motion sensor for an accurate step count, and also uses motion data during a walk to check that you're still on foot rather than in a vehicle.
Wockett only uses your calendar to find and delete the walk reminders an earlier version added. It no longer creates calendar events.
